terra.problem: Hahiroth is labeled a mountain, but the verses describe Pi-hahiroth as a camping place, not a mountain.
The line says Pi-hahiroth was near Baal-zephon; Numbers 33:7 says it was opposite Baal-zephon.
The crossing and journey to Marah happened after the people left Pi-hahiroth, not at Pi-hahiroth. The moment should focus on their departure from the place.
